audited_current_artifacts.revision_reason: Ledger predates exact-current labeler-v2, candidate-gate-v2 and their newly observed residual identity/derivation blockers.

material_findings.observed: entityos_hcu_trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v2.py accepts labeler_sha256 and generator_sha256 when they merely match the regex ^[0-9a-f]{64}$. It does not fetch, hash, load, or otherwise prove that those digests identify the labeler/generator bytes that produced the row.
material_findings.test_counterevidence: tests/test_entityos_hcu_trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v2.py uses 64 zeroes for both hashes and expects deterministic synthetic resolution to pass candidate admission.
material_findings.risk: A syntactically valid invented digest can satisfy the candidate gate, so the current phrase hash-bound is stronger than the executable identity check.
material_findings.required_successor: Bind synthetic_labeler_binding to exact committed/loaded labeler and generator bytes using a content-addressed manifest or execution receipt whose digest is recomputed/verified by the admission path; reject unknown, missing, mismatched, or unconsumed identities.

material_findings.observed: The semantic Hyperposition admission gate v2 introduced at commit 18d043475ac98e7f338f5bb43828b8ebfd308f69 explicitly loads trigger2_semantic_hyperposition_reference_labelers_v1.py, while main now contains a v2 labeler successor.
material_findings.risk: Passing the Hyperposition gate v2 can still reproduce v1 semantics and inherit v1 adversarial blockers; the gate version does not imply dependency freshness.
material_findings.required_successor: Resolve one exact labeler authority, bind its file/blob/content digest into the gate, and make dependency/version drift fail closed.

material_findings.observed: U_update in labeler v2 reads observation.effect from the caller and applies SUPPORT/WEAKEN/FALSIFY/PROVE/RETAIN. It does not derive the effect from executable task-world relations or a separately verified derivation receipt.
material_findings.risk: The missing target label is moved upstream; generator metadata can still manufacture a positive transition.
material_findings.required_successor: Derive update effects from typed synthetic-world semantics or verify an independently computed deterministic derivation receipt before state mutation.

material_findings.observed: D_resolve in labeler v2 trusts winner_branch_id and separates_live_branch_ids from discriminator_outcome after membership/coverage checks. The shown implementation does not derive the partition/winner from branch predictions plus an observed result and does not require an explicit admissible=true field before resolution.
material_findings.required_successor: Compute discriminator partitions/winner consistency from branch-local predictions and observed typed result, and fail closed when the discriminator is inadmissible or cannot separate all relevant live alternatives.

material_findings.observed: D_resolve returns RESOLVED_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD when exactly one live branch is marked PROVEN_WITHIN_SYNTHETIC_WORLD, even if another live branch remains compatible rather than mutually exclusive.
material_findings.required_successor: Require a machine-checkable exclusivity/coverage relation or a decisive discriminator that closes every competing alternative relevant to the query; otherwise remain UNRESOLVED.

external_method_inputs.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs, ICML 2025 / PMLR 267
external_method_inputs.training_implication: Track developmental checkpoint curves and distinguish shallow routing heuristics from systematic multi-hop binding; final aggregate accuracy is insufficient.

external_method_inputs.source: Xue et al., Why Supervised Fine-Tuning Fails to Learn, ACL 2026
external_method_inputs.training_implication: Use capability/family-level diagnostics because converged aggregate SFT metrics can hide persistently unlearned subsets.

external_method_inputs.source: Sharma, Dawes, Raval, Dissociating Decodability and Causal Use in Bracket-Sequence Transformers, arXiv:2604.22128
external_method_inputs.training_implication: Decodability is a representation result, not sufficient evidence of causal use; positive J-Space claims require matched interventions.

external_method_inputs.source: Makelov, Lange, Geiger, Nanda, Is This the Subspace You Are Looking for?, ICLR 2024
external_method_inputs.training_implication: Successful subspace intervention can exploit a dormant path; causal promotion needs anti-illusion/off-target controls rather than patching success alone.

successor_requirements: Derivation-bound U_update successor computes typed relation effects rather than accepting caller labels.
D_resolve successor derives outcome partition and winner from branch predictions plus observed discriminator result and requires admissibility.
Unique resolution requires explicit exclusivity/coverage semantics or equivalent decisive criterion.
Synthetic labeler/generator identity must be content-addressed and verified against the actual executable/loaded bytes, not regex-valid digest strings.
Hyperposition admission gate must bind the exact current labeler successor and fail on dependency/version drift.
Update the Trigger-2 artifact ledger with predecessor/successor/status/revision reason for all v2 artifacts.
Only after exact source tests plus model-visible leakage checks pass should positive D/E successor rows be materialized; accepted dataset tokens and training credit remain separate later gates.
next_exact_action: Build one derivation-bound semantic-Hyperposition labeler/gate successor that verifies exact executable labeler+generator content identity, computes U/D labels from typed synthetic-world relations, requires discriminator admissibility and exclusivity/coverage, binds the exact dependency version, then run adversarial mutation/property tests and update the version ledger before materializing any positive D/E training rows.
